name: Discrete Mathematics
short_description: Set theory, predicate logic, relations, combinatorics, and graph theory.
description: Formal discrete structures essential for computing: sets, functions, equivalence relations, mathematical induction, pigeonhole principle, permutations, combinations, and recurrence relations.

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics
courses.description: Formal mathematical logic, sets, relations, combinatorics, and induction proofs.

modules.title: Logic & Proofs
modules.description: The language of mathematics and how to argue in it.

topics.title: Propositional & Predicate Logic
topics.summary: Connectives, truth tables, logical equivalence, quantifiers, and negation.

topics.title: Proof Techniques
topics.summary: Direct proof, contrapositive, contradiction, and proof by cases.

modules.title: Sets & Relations
modules.description: Set operations, Cartesian products, equivalence relations, and partial orders.

topics.title: Sets, Functions & Cardinality
topics.summary: Set operations, functions, injections and bijections, and countable sets.

topics.title: Equivalence Relations & Partitions
topics.summary: Reflexive, symmetric, transitive properties and equivalence classes.

modules.title: Combinatorics
modules.description: Permutations, combinations, inclusion-exclusion, and Pigeonhole principle.

topics.title: Counting Principles & Pigeonhole Principle
topics.summary: Permutation formulas, binomial coefficients, and Dirichlet pigeonhole proofs.

topics.title: Permutations, Combinations & the Binomial Theorem
topics.summary: Arrangements and selections with and without repetition, and binomial coefficients.

modules.title: Mathematical Induction
modules.description: Weak induction, strong induction, and well-ordering principle.

topics.title: Induction Proof Techniques
topics.summary: Base case validation, inductive hypothesis, and inductive step.

topics.title: Recurrence Relations
topics.summary: Modelling with recurrences and solving linear recurrences with the characteristic equation.

modules.title: Graph Theory
modules.description: Vertices, edges, and the structures built from them.

topics.title: Graph Theory Fundamentals
topics.summary: Degrees, paths, connectivity, trees, and Euler and Hamilton circuits.

topics.title: Modular Arithmetic, GCD & Primes
topics.summary: Divisibility, the Euclidean algorithm, modular inverses, and an outline of RSA.
